Lina (CSM): Hi @Marco — welcome to Redwood! Kicking off a short 'Welcome Sprint' to get NovaRetail onto Dedicated. Can you confirm stakeholders and target launch date? Also flag any renewal concerns upfront.

Evan (Solutions Eng): Hey team — I'll own model integration and perf tuning. Expect initial test endpoint in ~2 weeks. Need sample payloads + expected QPS.

Marco (Client): Thanks Lina/Evan. Stakeholders: Marco (ops), Julia (data), Raj (security). Target pilot date: 2025-11-20. Renewal looks ok but we're sensitive to latency at peak.

Priya (Success Ops): Got it — I'll add those stakeholders to the plan and invite them. Marco, we'll use ephemeral dev API keys for early work; please confirm access method.

Sam (Onboarding PM): Draft timeline (high level):
```
Week 0: Access + quickstart
Week 1: Model integration + smoke tests
Week 2: Load tests + performance tuning
Week 3: Go/No-Go + enablement
```

Evan (Solutions Eng): For load tests we'll need target qps and token distribution. Marco — can you confirm peak qps and average tokens per prompt?

Marco (Client): Peak ~250 QPS, avg ~30 QPS, typical prompt ~60 tokens. Some bursts during promotions.

Lina (CSM): Noted. Renewal risk: MEDIUM because of latency sensitivity. Immediate actions: run a targeted perf test on Dedicated nodes and prioritize KV cache. @Evan can you propose a config?

Evan (Solutions Eng): Proposal in short: 8-GPU pool w/ mixed-precision quant, tuned batch sizes, and prefix KV caching for ~80% of traffic. I'll post a config snippet in the shared doc by EOD.

Priya (Success Ops): Enablement plan: two 60-min sessions (developer + ops). Proposed slots: Tue 11/12 11:00 PT and Thu 11/14 16:00 PT. Marco — which works?

Marco (Client): Thu 11/14 16:00 PT works best. Please send invites.

Lina (CSM): Feedback capture plan: run two weekly prompts-based evals during pilot and a short NPS at pilot end. Temporary feedback form: https://forms.gle/xyz123 (we'll replace with client-facing URL).

onboard-bot: Calendar invites created for Thu 2025-11-14 16:00 PT. Onboarding doc: https://redwood.example.com/onboarding/nova (internal link).

Sam (Onboarding PM): Next steps: Priya to send invites (today), Evan to post perf config (EOD), Marco to share sample payloads (by Fri), Lina to schedule checkpoint on 2025-11-18. Anything missing?

Marco (Client): I'll upload payloads by EOD. One additional ask: can we enable eu-west region for testing? Data residency requirement.

Lina (CSM): Noted — adding eu-west staging env and raising infra PR. Thanks everyone :rocket:
